# db

PostgreSQL and Redis helpers.

---

## `db_get_long_running_query`

Show queries that have been running longer than an interval, with the pid, user, wait event and state of each. Connection details come from DB_HOST, DB_NAME and DB_USER unless overridden.

**Usage**

```sh
db_get_long_running_query [interval] [database] [host] [user]
```

**Examples**

```sh
db_get_long_running_query
db_get_long_running_query '30 seconds'
db_get_long_running_query '1 hour' analytics db.internal readonly
```

**Requires** `psql`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/db.sh:30`](../../modules/common/db.sh#L30)

## `db_pg_gen_read_only_user_sql`

Emit the SQL that creates a read-only role and grants it SELECT across a schema. Prints only — review it, then run it yourself. The password must be supplied; there is no default.

**Usage**

```sh
db_pg_gen_read_only_user_sql <user> <password> [database] [schema]
```

**Examples**

```sh
db_pg_gen_read_only_user_sql reporting "$(openssl rand -base64 24)" analytics
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/db.sh:66`](../../modules/common/db.sh#L66)

**See also** `db_pg_gen_user_sql`

---

## `db_pg_gen_user_sql`

Emit the SQL that creates a database, its owning role, and full privileges on it. Prints only — review it, then run it yourself.

**Usage**

```sh
db_pg_gen_user_sql <database> <user> <password>
```

**Examples**

```sh
db_pg_gen_user_sql myapp myapp_user "$(openssl rand -base64 24)"
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/db.sh:100`](../../modules/common/db.sh#L100)

**See also** `db_pg_gen_read_only_user_sql`

## `redis_debug_sleep`

Block the redis server for N seconds using DEBUG SLEEP, to test how clients behave when redis stops answering. Prompts first.

> **⚠ DANGER** — The server serves NO requests for the whole duration. Never point this at production.

**Usage**

```sh
redis_debug_sleep [seconds]
```

**Examples**

```sh
redis_debug_sleep 5
```

**Requires** `redis-cli`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/db.sh:162`](../../modules/common/db.sh#L162)

## `redis_get_keyspace`

Show the keyspace section of `redis-cli info`: key counts and TTLs per database.

**Usage**

```sh
redis_get_keyspace [redis-cli-argument]...
```

**Examples**

```sh
redis_get_keyspace
redis_get_keyspace -h cache.internal -p 6380
```

**Requires** `redis-cli`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/db.sh:128`](../../modules/common/db.sh#L128)
